historical_record.description: The Anza Building, of red brick with classical detailing, was built during the French Hospital campus's first period of development, 1892 to 1930, as the hospital's School of Nursing.

The Foundation for San Francisco's Architectural Heritage rated the Anza Building 'B', of major importance, in its Inner Richmond survey; the building is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
